desc: If in the market for a silencer that will suppress your firearms yet is light enough that you will not be affected by its presence on your barrels, the Rugged Razor is ideal. Not wanting to sacrifice durability, the baffle stack is crafted with 100% Stellite, with the rest of the suppressor utilizing 17-4 stainless steel. The Rugged Suppressors Razor is as sturdy as a full-size suppressor, but easier to maneuver due to its shorter stature.
